sentences.text: Could Jack have fit on that door?
Rose survives on a floating piece of wood. Jack stays in the freezing water.
Fans have argued about it for almost thirty years.
Is the door big enough for two? Probably.
But size isn't the real problem. Buoyancy is. With two people on it, it starts to sink.
In twenty twenty three, the director ran a hypothermia experiment with stunt doubles.
His conclusion? Jack might have survived. Maybe.
So, fit or no fit? Comment below.
The full story of the two hundred million dollar bet is on the channel.
